plain: Order and control kept up by training and rules

webster.text: Education; instruction; cultivation and improvement, comprehending instruction in arts, sciences, correct sentiments, morals and manners, and due subordination to authority.

example.quote: The states are, by no part of the plan before you, precluded from arming and disciplining the militia, should Congress neglect it.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
